children: Knightscope filed a prospectus supplement to increase the maximum number of Class A common shares issuable under its At The Market offering.
Filed prospectus supplement to Form S-3 registration to raise the cap on Class A shares issuable under the ATM agreement.
The ATM agreement referenced is with H.C. Wainwright & Co., dated February 1, 2023, enabling ongoing sales.
Filing includes a legal opinion relating to the Shares as Exhibit 5.1.
Company notes this 8-K is not an offer to sell nor a solicitation; sales remain subject to state registration laws.
